description: Compute the platform-fee cost in USD of a buy plus sell round trip at a given trade size for spot-comparable venues (terminal, telegram-bot, launchpad, wallet, exchange, aggregator with a published round trip), sorted cheapest first. Network/gas fees, pool/LP fees and slippage are excluded. For perp-dex venues (when selected by category or slugs) taker and maker fees are reported instead. Live venues only unless slugs are given explicitly.

apply_referral_discount.description: Apply the venue's published referee fee discount (when it has a numeric one) to the platform fee. Default true.

category.description: Compare only this category. "perp-dex" returns taker/maker fees.

size_usd.description: Trade size in USD (one side), e.g. 1000.

name: compare_fees
title: Compare round-trip platform fees
